scope: Exercise allocation failure, rollback, same-codec retry, and typed readback through the public two-argument dxfRW::writeProxyEntity overload.

source.profile: AC1024 typed AcDbProxyEntity with valid proxy class/carrier/drawing-format fields and bounded 19-bit entity data; no object-ID references and no configured reference resolver.

implementation.change: Generalized the existing typed PROXY_ENTITY transaction control to run both its resolver-taking overload and the previously untested two-argument overload. The added profile has no object-ID references and uses no configured resolver.
implementation.method: Warm and calibrate each codec; inject std::bad_alloc at every reached entity-callback allocation; require destination sentinel preservation and caller handle/payload/reference preservation; retry with the same codec and require byte-identical output plus typed readback.

validation.resolverOverload: ASCII 11/11 and Binary 10/10 injected callback allocation failures pass rollback/retry/readback.
validation.twoArgumentOverload: ASCII 9/9 and Binary 9/9 injected callback allocation failures pass rollback/retry/readback.

limitations: Generated transaction and typed transport only; no physical producer prevalence, proxy object-ID graph closure, or application semantics are established.
The added two-argument profile deliberately contains no object-ID references; resolver behavior remains covered only by the existing resolver-taking profile.

planImpact.completedSlice: The public two-argument typed PROXY_ENTITY writer overload with an empty object-ID list, including full reached-allocation rollback and same-codec retry.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the public-writer inventory for other untested overloads, field variants, compound records, and variable-size OBJECTS builders.
